review_evidence: README describes the Lean adaptation of Algorithm Design with Haskell as turning informal equational reasoning into fully formal machine-checked proofs over divide-and-conquer, sorting, selection, greedy algorithms, data structures and related algorithms.
A complete scan of 31 Lean files found 123 theorem/lemma/example declarations and 695 declaration-style items.
The source combines algorithm definitions with correctness/equivalence/termination reasoning across the book chapters; this is directly within the formal prior-art information need.
summary: Reviewed fad and retain its machine-checked formalization of functional algorithm design.
